## Functional summary

This is **QueC (7-cyano-7-deazaguanine synthase)**, an enzyme in the biosynthesis of **preQ₀**, a precursor in queuosine biosynthesis. The sequence is an **exact, full-length match** to reviewed *Saccharolobus solfataricus* UniProt entry Q981C9, giving high confidence in the identification.

- **Length:** 464 amino acids  
- **Calculated mass:** 52.38 kDa  
- **Theoretical pI:** 6.20  
- **Reaction:** Uses ATP to convert 7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine to 7-cyano-7-deazaguanine (preQ₀); the annotated overall reaction uses two ATP and ammonium.  
- **Cofactor:** The reference annotation reports one Zn²⁺ ion per subunit.  
- **Domains:** Pfam detects GATase_7 and QueC-family regions, consistent with an amidotransferase-associated, QueC catalytic architecture.  
- **Other annotations:** ATP binding, zinc binding, and C–N bond-forming ligase activity; assigned to preQ₀ biosynthesis/purine metabolism.

Localization and oligomeric state are not established by the retrieved evidence. The mass and pI are sequence-derived estimates; cofactor and functional details come from the exact-match UniProt reference annotation.
